AAE.caption: PDF Url
AAE.doc: URL of the PDF to render. Accepts https://, http:// and Bubble file URLs starting with //
AAE.name: pdf_url

AAF.caption: pdf viewer ID
AAF.doc: (Optional) Legacy identifier, kept for backward compatibility. No longer required.
AAF.name: pdf_viewer_id

AAG.caption: Page to Fit
AAG.doc: (Legacy) Start with the whole page fitted in the viewer. Prefer the 'Initial Zoom' property.
AAG.name: page_to_fit

AAH.caption: Remove Download
AAH.doc: Hides the download button. Note: this hides UI only, it does not protect the file itself.
AAH.name: remove_download

AAM.caption: Remove Bookmark
AAM.doc: Hides the bookmarks (document outline) tab in the sidebar.
AAM.name: remove_bookmark

AAO.caption: Remove File Open
AAO.doc: (Deprecated) The new viewer has no file-open button; kept for backward compatibility.
AAO.name: remove_file_open

AAP.caption: Remove Right toggle
AAP.doc: (Deprecated) The new viewer has no right panel; kept for backward compatibility.
AAP.name: remove_right_toggle

AAR.caption: Viewer Language
AAR.doc: UI language: auto (browser language), en, pt, fr, es or de.
AAR.name: viewer_language

AAS.caption: Rename Download File
AAS.doc: If set, downloads use this file name (include the .pdf extension, e.g. document.pdf).
AAS.name: rename_download_file

AAT.caption: Search Word
AAT.doc: Term searched (and highlighted) automatically after the PDF loads. Can be changed dynamically.
AAT.name: search_word

AAU.caption: App Name
AAU.doc: (Optional) Your Bubble app name; used to normalize *.cdn.bubble.io file URLs.
AAU.name: app_name

ABA.caption: Show Thumbnails Panel
ABA.doc: Opens the thumbnails sidebar when the viewer loads.
ABA.name: show_thumbnails

ABB.caption: Protected Mode
ABB.doc: Hides download/print, disables right-click, text selection and Ctrl/Cmd+S/P/C inside the viewer. Note: no client-side protection is absolute.
ABB.name: protected_mode

ABC.caption: Watermark Text
ABC.doc: Dynamic diagonal watermark repeated over the pages (e.g. Current User's email). Leave empty for none.
ABC.name: watermark_text

ABE.caption: Theme
ABE.doc: Base color theme of the viewer chrome. Custom colors below override it.
ABE.name: theme

ABF.caption: Accent Color
ABF.doc: Color used for active controls and search highlights.
ABF.name: accent_color

ABG.caption: Initial Zoom
ABG.doc: Zoom applied when the document loads. 'auto' fits the page width.
ABG.name: initial_zoom

AAX.caption: Is Valid PDF?
AAX.doc: true when the current URL was loaded as a valid PDF
AAX.name: is_valid_pdf

AAY.caption: Total Pdf Pages
AAY.doc: Number of pages of the loaded PDF
AAY.name: total_pages

ABH.caption: Current Page
ABH.doc: Page currently visible in the viewer
ABH.name: current_page

ABJ.caption: Is Loading?
ABJ.doc: true while the PDF is being downloaded and prepared
ABJ.name: is_loading

ABK.caption: Search Results Count
ABK.doc: Number of matches of the last search
ABK.name: search_results_count

ABL.caption: PDF Title
ABL.doc: Title from the PDF metadata (may be empty)
ABL.name: pdf_title

ABM.caption: PDF Author
ABM.doc: Author from the PDF metadata (may be empty)
ABM.name: pdf_author

ABN.caption: Error Message
ABN.doc: Technical message of the last load/tool error (empty when none)
ABN.name: error_message

ABO.caption: PDF is loaded
ABO.doc: Triggered when the PDF finished loading and rendering started
ABO.name: pdf_loaded

ABP.caption: PDF failed to load
ABP.doc: Triggered when the URL could not be loaded as a PDF (see Error Message state)
ABP.name: pdf_error

ABQ.caption: Page changed
ABQ.doc: Triggered whenever the visible page changes (scroll or navigation)
ABQ.name: page_changed

ABR.caption: Search completed
ABR.doc: Triggered when a search finishes (see Search Results Count state)
ABR.name: search_completed

ABS.caption: Download started
ABS.doc: Triggered when a download is started (button or action)
ABS.name: download_started

ABT.caption: Print started
ABT.doc: Triggered when printing is started (button or action)
ABT.name: print_started
